visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with brown hair tied back, wearing a light beige shirt and a matching apron, is washing white rice in a silver metal colander. Her hands are submerged in the water, swirling the rice carefully. The setting is a modern, brightly lit white kitchen with a stainless steel sink and minimalist decor. (2) The woman opens a white multi-door refrigerator and takes out clear plastic food storage containers from a bottom drawer. The kitchen background shows light wood cabinets and organized counter space with various utensils. She is wearing white wireless earbuds while she works. (3) A close-up shows her hands adding dark fermented black beans from a small glass container into a white ceramic dish filled with pieces of raw, marinated meat. The counter is clean white, and the lighting is bright and even. (4) A white VOTTO brand steamer oven is shown on a shelf. The camera zooms in as the meat dish is seen inside through the glass door, with steam beginning to build up inside the illuminated compartment. (5) Fast cuts showing finished dishes: a plate of glazed beef ribs, and cabbage being stir-fried in a white pan with a wooden spatula. The lighting is warm and inviting, highlighting the textures of the cooked food. (6) She is shown tearing large cabbage leaves by hand into a clear plastic bin on the counter. Beside her is a package of dried ingredients. She works efficiently with a focused expression. (7) She pours a bag of long green beans into a silver colander in the sink and washes them under a strong stream of running water, adding a liquid from a small clear bottle to the mix. (8) She holds a metal tray containing several large, raw marbled beef short ribs towards the camera, showcasing the quality of the meat. The kitchen behind her is tidy and well-lit. (9) She uses a large professional kitchen knife to cut the beef ribs into smaller segments on a gray cutting board, demonstrating precise cutting technique. (10) The cut ribs are washed in a metal tray under the faucet. She uses her hands to rinse them thoroughly, ensuring all bone fragments are removed. (11) She opens a kitchen drawer filled with neatly organized white ceramic plates and bowls, selecting a square white baking dish for the next preparation step. (12) She adds oyster sauce, soy sauce, and black bean sauce from various labeled containers into the dish with the meat. Each sauce is added with a measured squeeze or spoonful. (13) She pours rice wine from a white bottle and then uses a gloved hand to mix and coat the meat thoroughly with the dark sauces, ensuring even marination. (14) She tops the marinated meat with thin ginger slivers and additional dry black beans from a storage container, preparing it for the steaming process. (15) She places the dish into the white steamer and presses a digital button. The digital display shows cooking parameters as she starts the appliance. (16) She trims the green beans into uniform lengths on the gray cutting board using a sharp knife. The action is quick and rhythmic. (17) She pours cooking oil into both a white and a black frying pan on a clean white induction cooktop, preparing for simultaneous cooking. (18) Minced garlic is added to the white pan and stir-fried with a wooden spatula until fragrant. The kitchen atmosphere is busy but organized. (19) The green beans and sliced carrots are added to the white pan, creating a colorful vegetable mix. She stir-fries them with quick movements. (20) She adds a spoonful of sugar and a splash of soy sauce for seasoning from clear containers, continuing to toss the vegetables. (21) The beef ribs are placed into the hot black frying pan, where they begin to sear and release steam. The camera captures the close-up texture of the meat. (22) She holds a gray squeeze bottle with a pink cap up to the camera, indicating the sauce she is about to use for the beef. (23) Using wooden chopsticks, she flips the beef ribs in the black pan, showing the beautifully browned and seared surface on each piece. (24) She takes several clean white plates out of a low kitchen drawer, preparing to serve the various dishes she has prepared. (25) She squeezes a dark brown black pepper sauce from the gray bottle over the searing beef ribs in the black pan. (26) The beef ribs are tossed in the pan with chopsticks, becoming coated in a thick, glossy dark sauce as they finish cooking. (27) Stir-fried cabbage is transferred from the white pan onto a clean plate, with steam rising from the hot vegetable dish. (28) A large metal pot on the stove is shown containing a soup with large chunks of yellow melon and pork ribs, simmering gently. (29) The steamer oven chimes and she removes the steamed pork rib dish using a beige silicone heat-resistant mitt, placing it on the counter. (30) All prepared dishes are laid out on a light-colored wooden dining table: steamed pork ribs, black pepper beef ribs, stir-fried green beans, stir-fried cabbage, and the pot of soup. (31) A final slow pan across the clean, minimalist kitchen showing all surfaces wiped down and everything put away in its place.
